guarantees.claim: iv_sel is continuously assigned the value of iv_sel_raw cast to the iv_sel_e enumeration type, with no range validation.
mux_sel_err is asserted (high) when any of data_in_prev_sel_err, state_in_sel_err, add_state_in_sel_err, add_state_out_sel_err, key_init_sel_err, or iv_sel_err is high.
guarantees.cond: combinational OR of the six error inputs

assumptions.claim: Each input sel_err signal (data_in_prev_sel_err, state_in_sel_err, add_state_in_sel_err, add_state_out_sel_err, key_init_sel_err, iv_sel_err) correctly indicates an invalid mux selection for its corresponding path.
assumptions.cond: when the corresponding mux select is illegal
assumptions.risk: If any of these error signals is false-negative or false-positive, the aggregated mux_sel_err will misrepresent the system health, potentially causing spurious FSM lockup/alert or allowing silent propagation of bad mux selections.

assumptions.claim: The iv_sel_err generation logic (outside this chunk) reliably detects any out-of-bounds iv_sel value that results from an out-of-range iv_sel_raw before that value is used in critical data paths.
assumptions.cond: when iv_sel_raw holds a value outside the legal iv_sel_e enumeration
assumptions.risk: If detection is missing or delayed, an illegal iv_sel may drive a mux that routes secret data or keys to an unintended destination without triggering the error aggregation.

uncertain_points.claim: The mux_sel_err output is intended to drive a control FSM that locks up and triggers an alert, but the timing and liveness of that FSM are not visible here. A slow reaction could allow corrupted data to propagate before the lockup.
uncertain_points.risk: If the FSM does not react within the same cycle or the alert mechanism has a latency, a payload could be outputted or a state corrupted before the system is halted.

uncertain_points.claim: The set of mux selector error signals aggregated into mux_sel_err may not be exhaustive; other muxes (e.g., for key or intermediate state feeds) could have error conditions that are not monitored here, leading to undetected illegal routing.
uncertain_points.risk: An unmonitored illegal mux selection could direct secret key or plaintext to an unauthorized sink without raising an alert.

uncertain_points.claim: The iv_sel assignment performs a raw enum cast without any range check, delegating all validation to iv_sel_err. If the iv_sel_err generation is buggy or its path has a timing gap, an out-of-range select could be used in muxes before the error is detected.
uncertain_points.cond: when iv_sel_raw is out of iv_sel_e range and iv_sel_err is not yet or never asserted
uncertain_points.risk: Sensitive data could be routed incorrectly in the cycle before error containment, leaking secret state or key material.
